releases.notes:
Full stable release for **Minecraft 1.20.1 / Fabric / Java 17**.

## Compatibility fixes

- **Composable skating friction:** replace the exclusive Mixin redirect with an expression hook that preserves other mods' friction adjustments. Non-skating movement retains the incoming friction unchanged.
- **Modded ice support:** gliding, ice particles and removal of the off-ice walking penalty share one surface check. It covers vanilla ice, `IceBlock` subclasses (including Immersive Weathering's Thin Ice), common ice tags and the extensible `legendarysurvivaloverhaul:skateable_ice` block tag. Other entirely custom ice blocks can be added by datapack. Thin Ice still cracks, breaks and melts normally.
- **Player-attributed blade damage:** player skate hits use normal player-attack damage with vanilla PvP/team restrictions and Fabric damage cancellation. Mob-worn skates retain mob attribution; spectators cannot inflict blade damage.
- **Wetness immunity:** Crimson Lily soaking and positive wetness API gains respect held/equipped Sponges, per-player wetness deactivation, configured mount immunity and Creative/Spectator. Protected mounts retain normal drying of existing wetness.
- **Independent thermal-system guidance:** detecting Scorchful or Frostiful logs a startup warning about overlapping temperature/wetness. LSO does not automatically disable or bridge either mod. To let the other mod own those systems, set both `temperatureEnabled = false` and `wetnessEnabled = false` in LSO's `temperature.toml`. Items remain separate.

## Updating

Back up worlds/configs and replace the old LSO JAR. No new required dependencies, settings or save migrations are introduced. All v3.2.0 survival gear/wet cooling and v3.2.1 lily Field Guide entries remain included.

**Fzzy Config and Trinkets remain strongly recommended, not required.** Installing Fzzy still requires its Kotlin dependency. IW, Scorchful, Frostiful and Thermoo are not required.

Actual Scorchful/Frostiful coexistence and arbitrary movement/protection mods are not claimed as tested. The wiki documents supported boundaries, configuration and the custom ice-tag path.

## Downloads

Install `legendarysurvivaloverhaul-fabric-1.20.1-3.2.2.jar`. The `-sources.jar` is for source/reference, not installation.

releases.notes:
# Wet cooling and survival gear

Full stable release for **Minecraft 1.20.1 / Fabric / Java 17**.

## New features

- **Configurable wet cooling:** at any nonzero wetness, cooling steps are 1.5x faster in every biome/dimension. Configure `wetCoolingRateMultiplier` in `temperature.toml` or the optional Fzzy editor. Existing saturation-scaled target cooling remains separate; warming is unchanged. Wetness and IW snowstorms multiply to 3x baseline cooling by default.
- **Crimson and Warped Lilies:** standalone Scorchful-derived plants generating in newly generated crimson/warped forest chunks. Full Crimson Lilies burst to soak players and harm tagged water-sensitive mobs; full Warped Lilies fill bottles/canteens. Water bottles or a canteen serving refill Crimson Lilies. Natural refill requires nylium/rooted dirt in ultra-warm dimensions.
- **Non-armored fur clothing:** Frostiful's fur appearance/names replace the winter suit. Existing `snow_*` IDs, armor/cold protection, durability, recipes and saved item data are preserved.
- **Ice Skates:** craft Fur Boots with two iron ingots for visible blades and ice gliding. Sprint to accelerate, sneak to brake; walking off ice is 50% slower. Blade landings deal one damage. Ordinary crafting does not transfer input boot enchantments, coatings or damage.

## Updating

Back up worlds/configs and replace the old LSO JAR. Existing configs receive the new setting without deletion; set `wetCoolingRateMultiplier = 1` for the previous cooling speed. There are now **264 settings across nine configs**.

**Fzzy Config and Trinkets remain strongly recommended, not required.** Installing Fzzy Config still requires its Kotlin dependency. Scorchful, Frostiful and Thermoo are neither bundled nor required; imported/adapted portions retain LGPL-3.0 licenses and attribution.

The wiki includes acquisition/interactions, upgrade guidance, the upstream wetness comparison, config details, credits and validation boundaries. Equipped visuals, skating feel and separate-client multiplayer remain in-game review items.

releases.notes:
## Optional Immersive Weathering integration

Adds optional support for **Atlasroar's Immersive Weathering 2.5.0+**, targeting **Minecraft 1.20.1 / Fabric / Java 17**.

- **Snowstorms:** force temperature toward frostbite or colder at **2x cooling speed**, with Cold Hunger during exposure. **Hot Drink** blocks both storm penalties.
- **Sandstorms:** force temperature toward heatstroke or hotter at **2x heating speed**, with Heat Thirst during exposure. **Cold Drink** blocks both storm penalties.
- **Freezing-wind hits:** apply or refresh Cold Hunger for **200 ticks (10 seconds)** from the last hit. This separate penalty is not blocked by Hot Drink; IW's push and Slowness behavior is preserved.
- **Shelter:** every column in a centered **3x3 area** must have sky-blocking cover within the first **10 blocks above the eye block**. A missing corner, higher roof, or skylight-transparent glass does not qualify.

Existing matching cold/heat immunity is respected. Storm-only penalties clear when exposure ends or the matching drink protects you; ordinary dangerous body-temperature effects can remain. Finite wind hunger survives storm overlap and saves.

## Configuration and installation

The independent, default-enabled `immersiveWeatheringStormsEnabled` switch is in `temperature.toml` and the optional Fzzy editor. It also requires `temperatureEnabled`; ambient secondary-effect toggles do not disable the storm integration.

**No new required dependencies.** IW and Moonlight are not bundled. The integration is inert without compatible IW; older IW versions disable it with a warning. If installing IW, install its own required dependencies.

**Fzzy Config and Trinkets remain strongly recommended, not required.** Installing Fzzy Config still requires its Kotlin dependency. LSO runs without all three. Existing TOML files remain valid and gain the new default, for **263 settings across nine configs**. Back up worlds/configs and replace the old LSO JAR; do not keep duplicate versions.

Player/developer documentation and the live wiki are updated. All v3.0.0 compatibility cleanup, canteen-only loot enchantments, and temperature-overlay fixes remain included.

## Validation and scope

Release build, configuration regressions, all 263 editor bindings, packaged resources, optional metadata, and the remapped wind hook were checked. Real dedicated-server assertions pass with IW 2.5.0/Moonlight present and with IW absent, including temperature rates/targets, shelter boundaries, drink protection, wind impacts/expiry, overlapping effects, saves, and disabled/Creative cleanup.

Storm client visuals and separate-client multiplayer remain unverified. A full release does not imply every mod combination is tested.

## Downloads

- **Install:** `legendarysurvivaloverhaul-fabric-1.20.1-3.1.0.jar`
- **Developers only:** `legendarysurvivaloverhaul-fabric-1.20.1-3.1.0-sources.jar`

releases.notes:
## Minecraft 1.20.1 - Fabric - Java 17

A full stable release with optional integration libraries, canteen-only loot enchantments, and a cleanup of bundled compatibility data. Includes the user-confirmed freezing/heat overlay fix from v2.8.1.

### Compatibility cleanup
Removed bundled support for Alex's Mobs, Atmospheric, Better End Forge, Born in Chaos, BYG, Call of Yucatan, Cataclysm, Crabber's Delight, Create, Create Confectionery, Crockpot, Curios, Decorative Blocks, Endergetic, Farmer's Respite, Forge, Hearth and Harvest, Seasonals, Survival Instinct, TerraFirmaCraft, Upgrade Aquatic, Valhelsia Structures, Wardrobe, and Quark, including Quark asset overrides. Obsolete generators, legacy defaults, and unused Forge modifiers were removed; retained recipes now use Fabric-compatible tags and NBT ingredients.

Farmer's Delight Refabricated and Fabric BetterEnd data are retained.

### Canteen enchantments
Refreshing, Purity, and Reservoir apply only to regular and large canteens. Find enchanted books in loot and apply them with an anvil; these enchantments are not offered by enchanting tables or villager trades. Level-based loot generation no longer puts them on unrelated equipment. Existing levels and effects are unchanged.

### Optional libraries
- Trinkets is optional for accessory slots. Held-item effects remain available without it; no new vanilla Respirator equip path is added.
- Fzzy Config is an optional in-game editor. Existing TOML configuration files work without it, using bundled NightConfig. Gameplay configuration synchronization is handled by LSO independently of the editor.
- Fabric Language Kotlin is not required by LSO. If you install Fzzy Config, you must still install Kotlin to satisfy Fzzy's own dependency.

Fabric API remains required. Cardinal Components base/entity and NightConfig core/TOML are bundled.

### Upgrading
Back up worlds and configs, replace the old LSO JAR, and keep only one LSO version installed. Existing TOML files are retained. Unequip accessories before removing Trinkets, and do not remove libraries still required by other installed mods. The major version follows the repository policy for changed dependency requirements and removed integrations.

### Validation and known limits
Java 17 build, packaged-resource checks, TOML/migration/validation/snapshot regressions, and all 262 optional editor bindings pass. Dedicated-server assertions pass with all three optional libraries present and absent. Actual multiplayer packet flow, in-game editor interaction, and a real Farmer's Delight Refabricated installation still need in-game checks; the resource fixture uses a synthetic loader alias.

### Downloads
Use `legendarysurvivaloverhaul-fabric-1.20.1-3.0.0.jar` to play. The `-sources.jar` is for developers.

## Hydration datapack support for 8 mods

Adds live Thirst hydration data for drinks (and a few related foods) from eight optional mods, as a pure JSON datapack — no compile-time dependency on any of them:

- Farmer's Delight Refabricated
- HerbalBrews
- Vinery
- Meadow
- Farm & Charm
- Bakery (Pudding Slice only — no dedicated beverages exist)
- Candlelight
- Brewery (covers both bottled drinks and keg/tap blocks)

See [Mod Compatibility](https://github.com/Atlasroar/LegendarySurvivalOverhaul/wiki/Mod-Compatibility) for full item coverage per mod.

releases.notes: Fixes the Left Shift hijack for players upgrading from pre-2.6.3 builds. v2.6.3 unbound the added_desc tooltip keybind's default, but Minecraft persists bound keys by name in options.txt, so already-saved installs kept the old Left Shift binding regardless of the new default. This release adds a one-time client-side migration that detects a saved added_desc binding still on Left Shift, clears it, and resaves options.txt, so vanilla sneak and other keybinds sharing Shift work again without manually rebinding in Controls.

releases.notes: Fixes the added_desc tooltip keybind (Thermometer/Coat item descriptions) hijacking Left Shift. Minecraft's KeyMapping system routes key events to only one binding per physical key, so defaulting this keybind to Left Shift silently blocked vanilla sneak and any other mod/custom keybind sharing that key. It now ships unbound by default; bind it yourself in Controls if you want the Shift-to-expand tooltip behavior. No other behavior changes.
